chunks: And one tasbih in Makkah is equivalent to the revenue of the two Iraqs spent in the way of Allah, Mighty and Majestic.

key_terms.الْعِرَاقَيْنِ: the two Iraqs, referring to a vast and wealthy region
key_terms.تَسْبِيحَةٌ: a single utterance of glorification of Allah
key_terms.تَعْدِلُ: is equal in value or reward to
key_terms.سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ: the way of Allah, meaning expenditure for His cause

ai.seo_question: What is the reward of saying one tasbih in Makkah?
ai.summary: This hadith emphasizes the immense virtue of dhikr in Makkah. It teaches that a single utterance of glorification there carries a reward comparable to a vast amount of wealth spent in the way of Allah, Mighty and Majestic.
